attempts.query: SAVA Gelaro SF6 independent ride review compliance vibration
attempts.note: Review reports noticeable vibration damping and compliance on washboard, chip-seal, hardpack and crushed limestone with stable endurance-gravel handling; qualitative only.

notes: Disposition: qualified. Exact SF6 review describes vibration damping and responsiveness but publishes no stiffness/deflection measurement or test method; affiliate links are present. Reopen trigger: Reopen with an exact-build independent test or controlled frame measurement.
